findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec/compile
 * @description Using eval, exec, or compile with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-eval
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("__import__").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially dangerous code execution function that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Code injection via eval, exec, or compile with potentially untrusted input

message.text: Potentially dangerous code execution function that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS)
 * @description Regular expressions with exponential worst-case complexity can cause denial of service
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 *        external/cwe/cwe-400
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string pattern
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "sub", "subn", "split"]).getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
  ) and
  exists(DataFlow::Node arg |
    arg = call.getArg(0) and
    arg.asExpr().(StrConst).getText() = pattern and
    (
      pattern.regexpMatch(".*\\(.*\\*.*\\+.*") or
      pattern.regexpMatch(".*\\(.*\\+.*\\*.*") or
      pattern.regexpMatch(".*\\(.*\\+.*\\+.*") or
      pattern.regexpMatch(".*\\(.*\\*.*\\*.*")
    )
  )
select call, "Regular expression may be vulnerable to denial of service with pattern: " + pattern
findings.hypothesis: Regular expressions with exponential backtracking that could cause denial of service

message.text: Regular expression may be vulnerable to denial of service with pattern: (\s*#.*$)
Regular expression may be vulnerable to denial of service with pattern: (\s|(#.*$))+
